months.title: Foundations
months.goal: Python for data, the math you need, and classic machine learning with honest evaluation.

months.title: How LLMs work and how to prompt them
months.goal: Understand transformers well enough to reason about cost, context and failure. Use LLM APIs with tools and structured output.

months.title: RAG
months.goal: Retrieval over your own data with MongoDB, measured with an eval set. First portfolio project.

months.title: Agentic AI
months.goal: Tool use, MCP, graph-based agents, multi-agent patterns and agentic RAG. Second portfolio project.

months.title: Production
months.goal: Evals, observability, security, cost control, deployment and serving.

months.title: Capstone and job search
months.goal: Ship a production AI feature in a MERN app, polish the portfolio, practise interviews, apply.

weeks.title: Python for AI work
weeks.outcome: Write and debug small Python scripts with an AI assistant.

weeks.title: Data with Pandas
weeks.outcome: Clean and summarise a real dataset.

courses.note: Do Python, Pandas and Data Visualization. Skip the rest.

weeks.title: Math you actually use, first ML models
weeks.outcome: Read vectors and matrices comfortably. Train and read a first model.

weeks.title: Machine learning with honest evaluation
weeks.outcome: Split data properly, pick metrics, explain overfitting.

weeks.title: Neural networks from the inside
weeks.outcome: Explain backpropagation and train a tiny network.

weeks.title: Transformers and GPT
weeks.outcome: Explain attention, tokens and context windows in an interview.

weeks.title: Prompting and the LLM API
weeks.outcome: Call an LLM API, control output, and handle errors.

weeks.title: The Hugging Face ecosystem
weeks.outcome: Use open models, tokenizers and pipelines. Know what post-training is.
weeks.checkpoint: Month 2 check: take a Daily 5 every day this week.

weeks.title: Embeddings and search
weeks.outcome: Turn text into vectors and find the closest matches.

weeks.title: Vector search on MongoDB
weeks.outcome: Store embeddings in Atlas and query them from Node.

weeks.title: Measuring RAG
weeks.outcome: Build an eval set and show retrieval and answer quality numbers.

weeks.title: Build project 2: RAG chatbot
weeks.outcome: A deployed RAG app with citations and an eval report.

weeks.title: Finish and publish the RAG project
weeks.outcome: Public repo, README with results, short demo.

weeks.title: Agent patterns
weeks.outcome: Explain when to use a workflow and when to use an agent.

weeks.title: Tools and MCP
weeks.outcome: Write good tool definitions and your own MCP server.

weeks.title: Graph-based agents
weeks.outcome: Build a stateful agent with branches and checkpoints.

weeks.title: Agentic RAG and multi-agent
weeks.outcome: Let an agent decide when and what to retrieve. Compare multi-agent frameworks.

courses.note: Pick crewAI or AutoGen for depth, skim the other.

weeks.title: Build project 3: tool-using agent with MCP
weeks.outcome: An agent with your own tools, guardrails and traces.

weeks.title: Security, cost and latency
weeks.outcome: Defend against prompt injection. Cut cost with caching and batching.

weeks.title: Evals and observability
weeks.outcome: Trace runs, score outputs and catch regressions.

weeks.title: Build project 5: eval harness
weeks.outcome: A golden set, a judge you checked against human labels, and a CI regression test.

weeks.title: Serve and ship
weeks.outcome: Wrap a model or agent in an API and run it in Docker.

weeks.title: Capstone, part 1
weeks.outcome: Design the AI feature in your MERN app. Auth, streaming and storage working.

weeks.title: Capstone, part 2
weeks.outcome: Rate limits, cost caps, logging, deployment and evals in place.

weeks.title: Portfolio, resume and profile
weeks.outcome: Three strong repos with READMEs, a resume with measurable bullets, a clean LinkedIn.

weeks.title: Interview sprint and applications
weeks.outcome: Mock technical rounds, one system design a day, applications going out.

optional.note: Fine-tuning is a useful stretch project but rarely required for application roles. Do it after week 13 if you have time.
